'''Crossgate Town''' (Japanese: '''クロスゲートタウン''' ''Crossgate Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]]. It is a small village nestled among mountains that are located somewhere between [[Littleroot Town]] and [[Fortree City]]. It appeared in ''[[AG080|That's Just Swellow]]''. 

According to {{an|Brock}}, Crossgate is known as "the crossroad of the winds". Indeed, the town is famous for its powerful tornadoes, as well as its annual [[PokéRinger]] tournament. {{pkmn|Trainer}}s from all around the world come with their {{type|Flying}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and try to become an {{wp|Honorary citizenship|honorary citizen}} of Crossgate Town.

Some of the town's residents include [[Shane]] and [[Volt]], both competitors in the [[Crossgate PokéRinger]]. {{Ash}} was made an honorary citizen after he won the competition by way of saving Pokémon from the Meowth Balloon.
